in connection with the transfer of its Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) business to RPG Active Pharma Limited, a subsidiary of RPG Life Sciences Limited through a slump sale. The transaction represents a significant consolidation within India's API sector and marks the transfer of a differentiated API business to a growth-focused platform.

Raghava Life Sciences has built a differentiated API organization comprising commercialized and development-stage products serving regulated and emerging markets. The business operates an EU-GMP approved manufacturing facility, maintains a diversified product portfolio, and brings proven regulatory capabilities. RPG Active Pharma, along with InvAscent (a pharma and life sciences-focused private equity firm), is positioned to accelerate commercialization of these assets, broaden market access, and unlock the next phase of growth for the business.

LKS provided comprehensive legal support throughout the transaction lifecycle. The firm's mandate encompassed drafting, review, negotiation and finalisation of all transaction documents, including the Business Transfer Agreement, Disclosure Letter, Conveyance Deeds, Employee Release Documents, etc., as well as full assistance with closing of the transaction.
